name: 六鱼鲜配方营养亮毛猫粮款

styleLock.direction: warm-trust pet nutrition ecommerce detail page
styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating soft blue-grey #D9E2EA photo backdrops, deep navy #1F2E4D infographic bands and pure white #FFFFFF breathing sections; steel blue #7FA3C4 and light blue #A9C6DC as secondary infographic circle colors
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio light with front-left key and gentle contact shadows on white scenes; flat even light on infographic bands and tables
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless paper-smooth studio backdrop; light wooden clipboard prop reserved for the spec card
styleLock.typography: bold high-contrast serif display for Chinese headlines; clean geometric sans-serif for micro-labels and chips, all in-image Chinese wrapped in 「」; fixed size hierarchy headline 28-48pt, labels 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circle icons, circular photo avatar frames, rounded rectangular chips and pills, large brush-style numerals for ordered lists
styleLock.presentationRules: stable straight-on and overhead presentation; emotional pet photography as co-star while the product or its kibble stays crisp in its own zone; balanced compositions with a clear focal hierarchy; consistent chip and circle geometry across shots
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm-trust pet nutrition ecommerce detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of soft blue-grey background #D9E2EA, deep navy #1F2E4D headline bands and infographic panels, pure white #FFFFFF breathing space, one vivid red accent #C63A2F for pills, ribbons and key data circles, plus steel blue #7FA3C4 and light blue #A9C6DC as secondary infographic colors; cool tone; bold high-contrast serif display for Chinese headlines with clean geometric sans-serif micro-labels, all in-image Chinese text wrapped in 「」; consistent rounded rectangular chips, circular avatar frames and thin-line circle icons; consistent large brush-style numerals for ordered lists; bright soft diffused studio light with front-left key and gentle contact shadows on white scenes, flat even light on infographic bands; stable product scale and placement with a clear focal hierarchy; no color palette changes, no mixed icon styles, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand names.

shots.intent: 用一句配方主张加情绪猫像在首屏一秒建立点击理由

shots.lighting: bright soft diffused studio light, front-left key, gentle contact shadow
shots.textZone: top 45% centered stack: navy chip, display headline, sub-banner chip, three-icon row, bottom chip
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: state the formula promise in one second with emotional pet warmth. Upper 45% is a centered infographic stack on soft blue-grey #D9E2EA: a small deep-navy #1F2E4D chip 「{callout_1}」, a huge deep-navy #1F2E4D serif display headline 「{selling_point_1}」, a navy #1F2E4D chip 「{selling_point_2}」 followed by a short note 「{callout_2}」, one row of three thin-line circle icons labeled 「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」, then a deep-navy #1F2E4D chip 「{callout_6}」. Lower 55%: eye-level 3/4 photo of a contented cat looking at the camera with {product} standing crisply beside it on the same blue-grey backdrop, bright soft diffused front-left light, gentle contact shadow, whiskers crisp; the cat and {product} together fill 50-60% of the frame. 2K vertical detail-page quality. Negative: no brand names, no watermark, no fake logo, no dense body text, no garbled characters, no extra props, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 源为 12 片 800x1200 详情页切片（相邻重叠 60px），拼合为一套猫粮详情长图。主产品判定依据：图内文案「6种鲜猫粮」「六种鱼配方·野生鱼类」、六种鱼成分圈列（沙丁鱼/鲭鱼/鳕鱼/比目鱼/岩鱼/蝶鱼）及参数卡「中大型猫粮 2500g」，故归类 宠物用品/主粮，leaf 定为六种鱼配方全价猫粮。已剥离：顶部店铺品牌条（含站外站名与竞品品牌字样）、红色 LOGO 旗标、二维码会员角标、底部英文占位乱文；源文案混入竞品品牌名与犬粮表述（成犬主粮/狗狗/爱犬），与猫粮主体矛盾，已统一改为占位符；图中具体营养数值（75% 肉质、85% 含肉量、42% 粗蛋白等）未经证实，全部以 {selling_point}/{callout} 占位符重建，不作为事实写入模版。panel-11 与 panel-05 为同一小猫+落粮素材的重复使用，合并为单镜。
